It’s really been a ride opening Albufeira coworking!

I, Rebecca, was so fed up by working from the kitchen, longing for connection and community - and together with my partner Ivo, we decided to do something about it. The idea was not only to have a shared space, but create a meeting point and community for people in similar situation. A place to share and exchange ideas, connect and help each other to grow (and have fun of course) . We couldn't be the only ones in Albufeira being in this situation?

After a lot of research and long hunt for the perfect venue (that's a whole another story!) we finally got the keys to Rua do Ténis 13, in the heart of Albufeira 🚪🔑. It’s a small place with 22 seats, but with a lot of heart. 

The doors opened at the end of November 2023. 

We are so lucky to have a group of amazing people sitting with us 🙌. It's freelancers, entrepreneurs, remote workers and employees, locals and expats, staying long-term and short-term. Programmers, designers, marketers, traders..

Whether you're looking for a place to work, network and grow or simply want to hang out over a beer or two - you are warm welcome to join the community.

We love to lunch together either in our dining room, on our patio or around the corner on the water. records.scea90e502: A spacious former dairy in Barcelona city center, District of Poble Sec, turned into a laid back coworking space. People used to buy fresh milk here and cream on Sundays. records.description_markdown: La Vaca is a big former dairy turned into a creative and relaxed Coworking in Barcelona city center, district of Poble Sec. Once, people used to get milk from this space; and now we are working from a vibrant and dynamic space called “La Vaca” which meand “The Cow”. We have a self service Cafeteria where we provide water, tea, coffee and milk for free. A bright and spacious ground floor where there are plenty of comfortable workstations. In the Basement we have a meeting room and other shared desks. Skype room, projectors, printer and scanner are also provided. Chill in our comfortable living room and just feel at home at la Vaca. What really makes La Vaca Coworking special is our vibrant and strong community, genuine connections and friendships among our coworkers.
